Regarding the question about the FTB and target. You can blindly take the trade when price returns, but I prefer not to. I wait for a engulf so I can be sure that the zone holds.

author: Keyador
text:
thetrendsfriend wrote: Thanks for the info! Why is that? I think in the markepedia article nothing about timeframes is mentioned....

It is because the FL that is created after the break of an important lvl is the most important, in this case it is the FL that is created after the break of the low. On the 4 hour chart you cant see what happend after the break of the important low, so we must zoom in to get a better look and find our FL.

Also Ifmyante stated that we must go in the lowest timeframe possible to find the FL, I think he said it on the thread on ForexFactory
